changelog: Jellyfin 12.1 support. Rebuilt against Jellyfin 12.1.0 on .NET 10 (targetAbi 12.1.0.0); requires Jellyfin 12.1 or newer (Jellyfin 10.11 users should stay on v1.12.0.0). Includes all v1.12.0 scan quality-of-life improvements. Also fixes the config page's Scan Schedule hour, which was silently ignored because it posted to a non-existent task-trigger route using the task Key instead of the task id.
description: Automatically manages a configurable tag for movies and series based on TMDb physical release data.
name: Physical Release Guard
overview: Scans your movie and series libraries and adds or removes a configurable tag based on whether a physical release exists according to TMDb data. Movies use TMDb physical release dates; series use TMDb DVD/physical episode-group evidence.
